result.summary: Found 2 issues: a missing restaurant image with a broken placeholder, and a promotional banner whose decorative background overlays the CTA button.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a generic broken-image icon instead of a restaurant photo, leaving a large empty gray area.
issues.suggestion: Load the restaurant image or use a proper branded fallback so the card isn't empty.

issues.description: A lighter green circle in the promo banner overlaps the 'Order now' button, making the button look cut off or poorly layered.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the decorative shape so it sits behind the button or doesn't intersect the CTA.
